title: A schema carrying one properly attributed bound
description: The counterpart to no-bounds.schema.json. The per-document bound-coverage check needs a document that is unambiguously bounded, so that an exemption naming this file is unambiguously a false claim about the corpus. The bound carries its x-authority so the document is clean under the attribution gate as well, and the only thing a control built on it can be failing for is the exemption.

charge.description: One bound, one authority keyed by the bound it explains.
